call_points.text: Order book was ₹1,853 Cr on 1 July 2026, against ₹1,863 Cr at the start of the year.
Air compressor division had its highest-ever quarterly order booking, led by Tezcatlipoca centrifugal machines.
Biogas order booking hit a record for a quarter, though from a small base.
Zephyros capex commitment is ₹320 Cr across FY27 and FY28, plus ₹100 Cr of other FY27 capex.
Two Zephyros packages are installed and a third goes in this month; the first order was received this month.
Precision engineering is expected to be 10-15% of the business in 5-7 years.
The company is debt-free, with no term or working capital loans, and its CRISIL rating was upgraded to AA.
Service income from gas-station O&M is expected to grow 25-30%, not the 50% seen in FY26.
Middle East package orders are deferred and may take quite some time; domestic demand is described as robust.
Some Q1 revenue slipped to Q2, a mix of package and product, and management would not quantify it.
Management guides for a sustainable EBITDA margin range of 18% to 20% for the compression business.
Order book stood at **₹1,863 Cr** as of **1st April 2026**, up 15% YoY.
FY26 order inflows crossed ₹2,000 Cr, setting an all-time high benchmark.
Committed ₹320 Cr capex under the government's PLI scheme for air conditioning packages and components.
Board approved sub-division of equity shares from face value ₹2 to ₹1 each.
Filed 57 IP applications in FY26, bringing total IP filings to 128.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹711.8 Cr (+20.3% YoY), net profit ₹143.7 Cr (+79.4% YoY).
Kirloskar Pneumatic reported all-time high FY26 order inflow crossing ₹2,000 Cr and committed ₹320 Cr PLI capex.
Kirloskar Pneumatic acquired the remaining 44.74% stake in Systems and Components India Private Limited for ₹12.55 Cr.
Kirloskar Pneumatic submitted the audio recording link for its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on April 27, 2026.
Kirloskar Pneumatic reported FY26 revenue of **₹1,786 Cr** and PBT of **₹356 Cr**, with an order book of **₹1,863 Cr**.
CRISIL upgraded Kirloskar Pneumatic's long term bank loan rating to AA (Stable) for ₹840 Cr facilities on May 5, 2026.
Atul Kirloskar, promoter of Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited, declares no encumbrance on promoter group’s 2,58,96,795 shares as of March 31, 2026.
Kirloskar Pneumatic launched 'Tonalli', a decentralised waste-to-energy solution, on May 19, 2026.
Rahul Kirloskar submitted the annual declaration of zero promoter share encumbrance under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI Takeover Regulations for FY26.
On 22 July 2026 Kirloskar Pneumatic's Q1FY27 call kept FY27 revenue guidance at ₹2,100 Cr and the 18-20% EBITDA band, reported an order book of ₹1,853 Cr on 1 July 2026 and a CRISIL upgrade to AA.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹326.3 Cr (-15.6% YoY), net profit ₹40 Cr (-8.7% YoY).
Kirloskar Pneumatic reported an H1FY27 order book of ₹2,040 Cr and signed an MoU with Kobe Steel for the oil and gas sector.
Kirloskar Pneumatic signed an MoU with Kobe Steel to jointly explore Oil & Gas business opportunities.

Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited informed the Exchange that the audio recording of the conference call for investors and analysts held on 27 October 2026 at 4:00 p.m. (IST) is available on its website.
